Important reminder for customers
It is easier with this note
Travelers with pets must review boarding and relief steps before arrival.

Pet travel notice

Please check all travel papers, carrier fittings, and leash arrangements before you reach the gate. The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers move through each step with calm guidance. If a concern comes up, staff will listen carefully and pass the matter to the safety coordinator for review. <<FACT F008>> Keep your pet close and follow staff directions at all stages of the journey.

For pet relief use, follow the posted access instructions and remain attentive to station signs. <<FACT F014>> If your pet shows stress, tell the nearest supervisor at once so support can be arranged without delay.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for help with readiness, handling, and airport guidance.
